translations.Det siste året har jeg egentlig brukt KI: Over the past year, I barely used AI. It was mostly a sparring partner when discussing ideas and thinking out loud about projects, without really using it in the actual development work.
translations.Når selve kodeskrivingen går raskere, fl: When the actual coding goes faster, more of the work moves to the beginning and the end. Without clear boundaries upfront and a thorough review at the end, the codebase quickly grows in the wrong direction.
translations.Dette er noe jeg fortsatt utforsker og l: This is something I am still exploring and learning along the way, so this is not meant as a rulebook or best practice for AI assisted development. These are simply habits that have worked well for me so far, and they will certainly change as I learn more and get better at using the tools.
translations.Før jeg skriver kode eller åpner en agen: Before I write any code or open an agent, I map out the data model and technical constraints on paper and in a dedicated AGENTS.md file. A language model does not know the target audience, platform quirks, or how lean the package list should be, so those choices must be locked down beforehand.

translations.Slank kode og en enkelt kilde: Lean code and a single source
translations.Jo flere filer og lag en modell må hoppe: The more files and layers a model has to jump between, the faster it loses track. I keep the code flat, gather shared data in one place instead of spreading it across multiple files, and clean up structural noise along the way. This keeps the context down to 100 to 200 lines at a time and makes the code easy to understand for both the team and my future self.
translations.Når tempoet øker, blir sikkerhetsnettet: When the pace increases, the safety net becomes even more important. I work in small, frequent commits and keep refactoring separate from new features, so it is always safe to roll back and easy for others to follow the history. Before changes go to production, I check them with automated tests and a review of critical user flows.
translations.På GitHub ligger det mange raske eksperi: On GitHub, there are many quick experiments where I am just testing a tool or an idea on the fly. They work fine as scratchpads. The projects I show here are built to hold up when you look under the hood, where my own choices drive the architecture, flow, and details.
translations.Det samme gjelder det visuelle. Her i po: The same goes for the visuals. Here in the portfolio, the cards show the actual pages, components, and features I have built, so you see my work. Where AI is the whole point, like the 3D version of me on the front page, it is clearly marked.

translations.Til daglig jobber jeg med IKT drift og s: In my day job, I work in IT operations and support at Nord-Gudbrandsdal VGS. During recess, we saw that there was already plenty of life and activity around the table tennis tables in the cafeteria, while a group of students struggled to find their way in and ended up sitting on their phones instead.
translations.Prosjektet startet som et forsøk på inkl: The project started as an attempt at inclusion and to create even more engagement around the tables. As a former video game nerd, I wanted to build something fun that lowered the threshold for joining and reinforced the desire among students to participate actively and physically in a shared activity during breaks.
translations.Lavterskel gjestespill og rask kampflyt: Easy guest play and fast match flow at the table
translations.Hele poenget med løsningen er at elevene: The whole point of the app is for students to play table tennis rather than standing around tapping a screen. The flow at the table is set up so the phone is only used for a few seconds before and after a match.
translations.Når to spillere skanner QR koden ved sam: When two players scan the QR code at the same table within 45 seconds, they are paired up and the match starts automatically. Phones go back in pockets while the sets are played, and afterwards one player taps a quick result button (1-0, 2-0, or 2-1) while the opponent confirms with a single tap.
translations.Gjestespill med poeng på vent: Elever ut: Guest play with points on hold: Students without an account who scan the table go straight into a match as a Guest without filling out a registration form first. They can save up to 3 wins (9 points) on hold, and when they create a profile or log into an existing account afterwards, matches and points move over automatically while the temporary guest profile is deleted.
translations.Spill mot vinneren og umiddelbar bordfri: Play against the winner and immediate table release: As soon as the first player enters the final result, the table is freed immediately and remembers the winner for 20 minutes. Then two new players can scan the QR code in turn, a new challenger can scan and tap Play against the winner without the winner having to take out their phone, or the previous pair can have a rematch with a single tap. If someone forgets to finish, the table is freed after 12 minutes.
translations.Sesjonsbro mellom kamera og hjemskjerm (: Session bridge between camera and home screen (PWA): Since iOS separates storage between regular Safari and apps on the home screen, the session is synchronized via the manifest so that students stay logged in when they scan the QR code with the mobile camera.
translations.Valideringslogikk mot juks og Boss Fight: Validation logic against cheating and Boss Fight: Valid results are approved automatically after 60 seconds, while unnaturally fast matches (under 45 seconds per set) are stopped and flagged to the organizer. The same pair of players cannot lock the leaderboard by playing each other twice in a row (max 2 ranked matches per pair per day), and staff can join as a Boss Fight with at most one ranked trophy per staff member per day.
translations.For å skape samhold på tvers av trinn og: To build team spirit across grades and classes, the system has class teams and digital paddles with a local touch from the school and Innlandet. Each paddle tracks matches played, wins, and previous owners. Every third completed tournament, the school rotates to a new seasonal pack, and when third year students graduate, unlocked paddles move into the school trophy vault.
translations.Storskjermen i kantina og erfaringer med: The cafeteria large screen and experience with Infoskjermen.no
translations.En av de mest lærerike tekniske utfordri: One of the most interesting technical challenges came up when the scoreboard (/kiosk) had to run all school day long through Infoskjermen.no on older Samsung and LG TV screens. On regular mobile phones and PCs, everything worked on the first try, but inside locked TV web browsers, the display behaved completely differently.
translations.24 fps animert WebP fremfor <video>: All: 24 fps animated WebP instead of <video>: All animations on the large screen are created with ffmpeg as 24 fps animated WebP inside a <picture> element with a GIF fallback.
translations.Tre synkroniserte visningslag og TV test: Three synchronized display layers and TV testing: The large screen is first delivered as complete HTML from the server (SSR), upgraded to real time Socket.IO in modern browsers, and has a dedicated client in pure ES5 (with 3 second polling and measuring actual elapsed time) for older TV screens. The fallback views can be tested directly in a regular browser with ?mode=es5 and ?mode=ssr.
translations.Diagnosestempel og tidsstyrt dvale: Nede: Diagnostic badge and scheduled sleep: In the bottom right corner, the screen displays the active mode (LIVE, POLL, ES5, or SSR) and automatically reloads itself when a new version is rolled out. Outside of school hours, the large screen goes into sleep mode and wakes up again at the start of the next school day.
translations.Løsningen er bygget i Node.js med inneby: The solution is built in Node.js with built in node:sqlite in WAL mode and only 5 npm packages (express, socket.io, dotenv, qrcode, and web-push). Multiple schools run separately on the same instance via school_id in the database and dedicated Socket.IO rooms, inside a closed Docker container on Fly.io in Stockholm with fixed persistent storage, CalVer versioning, and automatic backup (VACUUM INTO) on new releases. Before rollout, the system was stress tested with 100 concurrent players across two schools without errors.
translations.Fordi løsningen brukes av skoleelever, e: Because the solution is used by students, privacy (GDPR Article 25) is built right into the data model. As soon as a school organizer verifies a student, temporary names and email addresses are permanently deleted with NULL values in the database, while unverified data is automatically cleared after 14 days and empty guest sessions after 24 hours. Only a one way HMAC-SHA256 hash is kept for login, students can delete their own accounts on the spot, and organizers can generate an anonymized activity report for the school featuring weekly pulse, daily rhythms, and timelines, with A4 PDFs and Excel files generated without external packages.

translations.Da Kim og jeg skulle forme merkevaren og: When Kim and I shaped the brand and messaging for Ember Booking, the work started by defining our ideal customer, and just as importantly, who we choose not to target for now. Our target audience consists of busy owners of small and medium businesses who juggle many tasks and want to spend as little time as possible on administration and as much time as possible on their customers, campaigns, and operations.
translations.To konkrete kundeprofiler og smertepunkt: Two concrete customer profiles and pain points guided the positioning, copywriting, and structure of the website:
translations.Ronny (Honndalen Gym og Sauna): Driver t: Ronny (Honndalen Gym and Sauna): Runs a fitness studio, group classes, and saunas. Before Ember, he spent up to a full workday each month pulling reports, checking Vipps payments in Excel, and entering accounting vouchers manually into Tripletex.
translations.Deving (ATV utleie og naturopplevelser p: Deving (ATV rental and nature adventures on the west coast): Frustrated with established rental systems (such as Periode.no, Gibbs, and Sharefox) that market themselves as simple, but in practice require lengthy training and are packed with features the business does not need.
translations.Innsikten fra bedriftseierne gjorde det: Insights from business owners made it easy to strip away vague marketing jargon. When someone asks what sets Ember Booking apart from older systems, our positioning and website copy boil down to three concrete promises:
translations.Vipps registrering på sekunder uten lang: Vipps registration in seconds without long forms: Many systems force guests to fill out lengthy forms and create passwords just to book an appointment. With Vipps or card payments (Stripe and PayPal), the customer is registered and paid in seconds.
translations.Ferdig avstemt regnskap: Alle transaksjo: Fully reconciled accounting: All transactions are automatically reconciled against Tripletex and Fiken, and the system sends out SMS and email confirmations for every reservation. Business owners only need to review the numbers instead of doing manual bookkeeping.
translations.Klar til bruk på en dag uten opplæringsk: Ready to use in a day with no training courses: The system only contains the functionality rental businesses actually use in their daily operations, without extra modules that make setup heavy.

translations.Selve oppbyggingen av emberbooking.no (b: The structure of emberbooking.no, built in Next.js 16, is designed to answer the questions and doubts a business owner has before taking the plunge and switching systems:
translations.Over folden (Hero): Tydelig verdiforslag: Above the fold (Hero): A clear value proposition ("One booking system for all your resources"), a brief explanation of how booking, payment, and accounting connect, a primary call to action, and low friction ("No commitment period").
translations.Hvorfor Ember (3 raske kort under Hero):: Why Ember (3 quick cards below the Hero): Shows the difference from heavy competitors at a glance with fast Vipps checkout, targeted features, and an automated workday.
translations.Fra smertepunkt til løsning: Setter førs: From pain point to solution: Starts by naming the frustration of Excel sheets, manual exports and imports, and heavy systems, before presenting automated accounting, fast payments, and resource management.
translations.Bruksområder og sosial tillit (Social Pr: Use cases and social proof: Industry cards (such as saunas with planned heater and lighting control, gyms, and ATV and car rentals) and customer stories from pilot customers saving 5 to 7 hours a month are placed naturally down the page.
translations.Åpne priser og FAQ: Tydelige pakker uten: Transparent pricing and FAQ: Clear packages with no hidden costs and answers to the most common questions about accounting integration, setup, and commitment periods, followed by a final call to action.

translations.Målet med porteføljen var å lage en løsn: The goal of the portfolio was to build a setup where visitors can talk with an AI version of me in a normal conversation while it shows them around the screen, and at the same time show how real time voice and visual navigation can solve tasks in healthcare, schools, and customer service. The solution runs a shared 3D model inside a dedicated Web Worker, streams replies and a cloned voice from Gemini over SSE, and sticks strictly to approved facts.

translations.Tanken bak oppsettet var å teste hvor næ: The idea behind the setup was to test how close you can get to a normal spoken conversation on the web when the model speaks with a natural voice, controls what you see on the screen, and at the same time sticks strictly to approved facts.
translations.Stemmen er klonet fra et 17 sekunders ly: The voice is cloned from a 17 second audio recording and streamed in real time over SSE from /api/chat. When audio is enabled, the chat bubble waits to appear until the first audio chunk actually starts playing in the Web Audio API, so text, voice, and lip movements line up.

translations.ui-craft: Faste rammer for fargebruk, ty: ui-craft: Fixed rules for color usage, typography, spacing, and calm surfaces in the interface.

translations.Da jeg tok i bruk kodeagenter mer system: When I started using code agents more systematically in the autumn of 2026, I quickly saw that quality depends on the boundaries you set before building. I gathered my rules into an open repository at github.com/yosang/skills, setting clear requirements for lean architecture, calm interfaces, and natural language across projects.
translations.Hvorfor jeg samlet reglene i et eget rep: Why I gathered the rules in a dedicated repository
translations.Da jeg høsten 2026 gikk inn for å bruke: When I started using AI assisted software development more systematically in the autumn of 2026, I quickly noticed that quality depends on the boundaries you set upfront. Without fixed limitations, language models tend to add unnecessary abstractions, defensive code that hides errors, and visual noise.
translations.Ved å samle reglene i et eget repo som f: By gathering the rules in a dedicated repository that follows the Agent Skills standard (compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and Gemini CLI), I can apply the same requirements to every new project.
translations.Repoet er delt inn i tre moduler slik at: The repository is divided into three modules so that each task only loads the rules actually needed:
translations.ui-craft: Bygger på Matt D. Smiths 3P ra: ui-craft: Built on the 3P framework by Matt D. Smith (Purpose, Principles, Personality) and the 60-30-10 color rule. Cuts out random glow effects and oversized cards in favor of matte surfaces, calm OKLCH colors, fluid typography (Utopia.fyi) capped at 62 characters per line, an 8pt spacing system, and media that pauses outside the viewport.
translations.lean-architecture: Holder konteksten kor: lean-architecture: Keeps context short and requires locking down the data model and platform constraints on paper and in AGENTS.md before coding. Focuses on Spike and Stabilize by Dan North, a single source of truth for shared data, small and safe commits without mixing refactoring and new features, early cleanup of logical and structural code smells, and documenting silent production gotchas in README.md.
translations.natural-copy: Fjerner typiske KI uvaner: natural-copy: Removes typical AI habits in both Norwegian and English text, such as dashes, unnecessary hyphens between technical terms and Norwegian words, empty clichés, and stiff literal translations. Also requires project copy and applications to start with human motivation before technical details.
translations.Her er også skills repoet mitt med faste: Here is also my skills repository, containing fixed rules for architecture, design, and language when I use AI.

translations.MedCare Clinical ble bygget over fem uke: MedCare Clinical was built over five weeks as the final exam project for the two year backend development program at Noroff. The assignment was to plan, model, and develop a complete clinic appointment booking system in C# and .NET 9 with MySQL and a corresponding React client.
translations.Før jeg skrev en eneste linje C#, brukte: Before writing a single line of C#, I spent the first few days reviewing the requirements specification, refreshing my knowledge of normalization, and drawing the ER diagram in third normal form (3NF). Among other things, I separated cities, categories, and statuses into their own tables linked to clinics and appointments.
translations.Da modellene og relasjonene var satt opp: Once the models and relations were set up in Entity Framework Core, I wanted to be certain that the C# code produced the exact database structure I had planned. I ran mysqldump from MySQL and imported the schema back into dbdiagram.io to verify that tables, foreign keys, and unique indexes matched the ER diagram.
translations.GlobalExceptionHandler: Satte opp sentra: GlobalExceptionHandler: Set up centralized error handling early in week 1 so the service layer did not need repetitive try/catch blocks in every method.
translations.Swagger med XML dokumentasjon: Konfigure: Swagger with XML documentation: Configured Swagger at /doc with XML comments, example data, and response codes for every endpoint.
translations.GitHub Actions CI: La inn automatisk byg: GitHub Actions CI: Added automatic build verification on every push right from the start, ensuring no commit could silently break the build process.
translations.Etter hvert som antallet entiteter og DT: As the number of entities and DTO objects grew, manual mapping in the service layer became cluttered. I considered libraries like AutoMapper and Mapperly, but chose to write custom extension methods in C# (such as ToAppointmentWithDetailsDTO and ToClinicDTO) along with an UpdateWith helper method for partial updates. This kept the services readable without adding extra packages.
translations.Samme uke endret jeg fødselsnummer (Nati: That same week, I changed the national identity number property from an integer to an 11 character string, since Norwegian ID numbers can start with 0 and are never used for mathematical calculations.
translations.For å hindre dobbeltbooking la jeg først: To prevent double booking, I initially added composite unique indexes in the database on DoctorId + AppointmentDate and PatientId + AppointmentDate. During testing, I discovered that the index only stopped two appointments starting at the exact same minute, but failed to block a new booking at 10:15 if the doctor already had a 30 minute appointment from 10:00 to 10:30.
translations.Jeg måtte sette meg ned med penn og papi: I had to sit down with pen and paper to map out the timelines to be 100 percent sure the date validation caught all variations of overlaps, both for new bookings and when a registered patient modifies an existing appointment.
translations.Gjenbruk av pasientprofil ved gjestebook: Reusing patient profiles for guest bookings: Patients without an account can book appointments using their name, date of birth, phone number, and email. If the same person books again later or creates a full user account, the backend reuses and upgrades the existing patient row instead of creating duplicates.
translations.Soft delete ved avbestilling: Avbestilte: Soft delete on cancellation: Cancelled appointments are kept in the database with a status for historical records without blocking that time slot for new patients.
translations.I starten av arbeidet med frontenden bru: Early in the frontend development, I used Zustand for everything, including fetching lists of doctors and appointments. This resulted in a lot of repetitive code and unnecessary useEffect calls. Even though I was behind schedule after catching the flu halfway through the project, I decided to refactor data fetching to TanStack Query (using useQuery, useMutation, and useInfiniteQuery with backend pagination), while keeping only pure client state like the active token and theme in Zustand.
translations.Kortlivet Access Token i minnet + httpOn: Short lived access token in memory plus httpOnly refresh cookie: Access tokens (lasting 1 to 15 minutes) are kept exclusively in memory. When a protected endpoint responds with a 401, the client automatically calls POST /api/Auth/refresh with an httpOnly cookie (lasting 7 days) and renews access without the user noticing.
translations.Rollebasert tilgangskontroll (RBAC): For: Role based access control (RBAC): To prevent regular logged in patients from modifying lookup tables such as clinics, cities, and specialties, I added a dedicated Role table (Patient and Admin) and locked down write endpoints with [Authorize(Roles = "Admin")].
translations.Innspurt og optimalisering: Brukte react: Final push and optimization: Used react-scan to clean up unnecessary UI updates, gathered duplicate JWT settings into JWTTokenValidationParameters, moved CORS settings out to appsettings.json, and shifted all sorting and filtering of appointments from the frontend table over to the backend.
translations.Under skoleprosjekter ligger MedCare Cli: Among my school projects is MedCare Clinical, my backend exam project at Noroff featuring doctor appointments built with C# and .NET 9.

translations.Cinemorra ble bygget som skoleoppgave på: Cinemorra was built as a frontend school assignment at Noroff with the goal of creating a clear movie catalog where users can easily explore, search, and rent films online, while administrators manage the catalog in a dedicated admin panel. The solution is built in the Next.js App Router and TypeScript with a clear separation between public pages and administration.
Route structure and access control in the Next.js App Router
translations.Tilgang til adminrutene sjekkes i middle: Access to the admin routes is verified in middleware.ts before the page renders, and each route has dedicated loading and error states so the user always gets clear feedback during network errors or slow lookups.
translations.Server Actions, klientstate og automatis: Server Actions, client state, and automated tests
translations.Innlogging, utlån og endringer i filmkat: Login, rentals, and changes to the movie catalog run through Next.js Server Actions with server form validation. In the browser, Zustand is kept strictly for pure UI state such as active search filters, rental status, and toggling between light and dark mode.
translations.Komponenttester med Jest og React Testin: Component tests with Jest and React Testing Library: Verifies that search, filtering, form submissions, and error messages behave properly during user interaction.
translations.Accessibility i skjemaflyt og kort: Sjek: Accessibility in form flows and cards: Checked automatically with eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y to ensure semantic form elements, clear focus indicators, and full keyboard navigation.
translations.Til slutt finner du Cinemorra, en filmka: Finally, we have Cinemorra, a movie catalog with rental features and a custom admin panel built in Next.js and TypeScript.
translations.Allerede på dag 2 i drift ved Nord-Gudbr: By day 2 in production at Nord-Gudbrandsdal VGS, the activity report showed clearly how students were using the app in the cafeteria. From 4 matches during lunch on day 1, activity jumped to 21 completed matches before 13:20 on day 2 on a single table, with 28 registered profiles (plus guest sessions up to paddle number 33) and 15 different players with ranked matches.
translations.Basert på observasjonene fra de to først: Based on observations from the first two days, we added three concrete changes the same day to stay ahead of typical school day challenges:
translations.Timeplanstyring for bordene i skoletiden: Schedule management for tables during school hours: To prevent matches from spilling over into class time when the bell rings, organizers can now set fixed time windows for breaks and lunch when the tables are open for match starts, combined with temporary unlocks for free periods or gym class.
translations.Kallenavnmoderering med 24 timers varsel: Nickname moderation with a 24 hour notice: Since teenagers are quick to find creative wordplay that bypasses standard word filters on the big screen, organizers were given tools to change inappropriate nicknames directly without deleting player points. The student can still log in with their old nickname, sees a notice for 24 hours explaining why the name was changed, and is blocked from switching back to the banned name.
translations.Motstanderbekreftelse ved modusbytte i k: Opponent confirmation for match mode switching: To prevent one player alone from switching a ranked match to free play when they are losing, changing between tournament and free play modes now requires confirmation from the opponent before the result can be submitted. In case of a disagreement over the result, the match quietly goes to conflict resolution in the organizer panel without blocking the table for the next pair.
translations.sessionStorage (ai-twin-chat): Husker på: sessionStorage (ai-twin-chat): Remembers your active chat thread while you click between pages in the same tab. Automatically deleted when you close the tab.
translations.For å beskytte API kvoten mot automatise: To protect the API quota from automated spam, the server keeps a simple counter per IP address in memory that resets continuously. IP addresses are never written to disk or any database.
translations.Når du sender en melding, bruker mikrofo: When you send a message, use the microphone, or enable audio in the chat, your request is sent encrypted (HTTPS) to the Google Gemini API to generate text replies, transcribe speech to text, and play the cloned voice. Every call for text replies, speech to text, and voice is sent with storage turned off (store: false).
translations.Enten skrev du inn feil URL, eller så ra: Either you typed the wrong URL, or neither I nor my model got around to building this page yet.
translations.Hvordan sikrer du chatten mot prompt inj: How do you secure the chat against prompt injection?
translations.Her var strategien helt motsatt. Jeg gjo: Here the strategy was completely opposite. I did the groundwork myself, created assets in Figma, and built the design system by hand. I only used AI at the very end to catch inconsistencies and syntax errors before deploy.
translations.Arkitektur og sikkerhet: Delt 3D modell: Architecture and security: Shared 3D model with 20 blendshapes running in a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker at 60 fps, paired with real time TTS, speech to text, and prompt injection defenses.
translations.Delt 3D modell i egen Web Worker på 60 f: Shared 3D model in a dedicated Web Worker at 60 fps
translations.Avataren er en 3D skanning av meg med 20: The avatar is a 3D scan of me with 20 blendshapes for lip sync, blinking, and facial expressions, combined with skeletal neck and head tracking. So the 3D view never blocks the main thread or slows down scrolling, the canvas runs inside a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker (avatar.worker.ts).
translations.En og samme WebGL og Worker instans flyt: A single shared WebGL and Worker instance moves directly via a DOM portal between the front page hero, the floating corner dock, and the fullscreen studio (/chat), loading the 3D model only once in memory. Three.js boots on first interaction and pauses automatically via IntersectionObserver whenever the avatar leaves the viewport.
translations.Synkronisert stemmekloning og tale til t: Synchronized voice cloning and speech to text
translations.En språkmodell gjetter bare neste ord ut: A language model only guesses the next word based on probability, so it can always be tricked if someone tries prompt injection. Therefore, the actual security must live in standard TypeScript code surrounding the model:
translations.Skille regler og meldinger: Systemprompt: Separating rules and messages: The system prompt is built exclusively from fixed files on the server. Anything you write or say into the microphone is stripped of control tags and wrapped in dedicated tags (<untrusted_visitor_input>) so the model sees the difference between my rules and outside messages.
translations.Fast sjekk i kode: Modellen får aldri ve: Strict checks in code: The model is never allowed to pick arbitrary links or files on its own. Tags that switch pages ([GO:...]) or scroll to projects ([TOUR:...]) are checked against a fixed list in code on both the server and the client before anything happens, and the CV is only sent out when you actually ask for it.
translations.Ingen lagring og faste grenser: Alle kal: No data storage and strict limits: All calls to Gemini run with data storage turned off (store: false). In addition, the server verifies that the request comes from my own site, with hard limits on how many messages and audio clips can be processed per minute and per day.
translations.Les mer i caset om Interaktiv Portefølje: Read more in the case study on Interactive Portfolio
translations.Sikring mot prompt injection i praksis: Securing against prompt injection in practice
translations.Siden en språkmodell alltid kan bli fors: Since someone can always try to trick a language model, I moved these checks out into standard TypeScript code (apiGuard.ts) surrounding the model:
translations.Skille regler og brukerinput: Systemprom: Separating rules and user input: The system prompt is built only from fixed files on the server. Chat messages are stripped of control tags and placed inside <untrusted_visitor_input>, and the history is sent with locked roles (user_input and model_output) so no one can fake previous replies in the thread.
translations.Fast liste over lovlige handlinger: [GO:: Fixed list of allowed actions: [GO:<path>] is checked against a fixed list of valid pages on both the server and the client before router.push runs, ensuring the model can never send anyone to external websites. [FILE:cv] points to a specific PDF file and is only released when you explicitly ask for the CV.
translations.Ingen lagring og faste kvoter: Alle kall: No data storage and fixed quotas: All calls for chat, voice, and speech to text are sent with store: false, alongside checks for Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site, plus rate limits per minute and per day in memory.
translations.Prosjektet startet fordi vi ville gjøre: The project started because we wanted to make it easier for more students to join in around the table tennis tables during breaks instead of sitting on their phones.
translations.Ved bordet skanner to spillere QR koden: At the table, two players scan a QR code within 45 seconds, put their phones away while playing, and can even queue up to three wins as guests before creating a profile.
translations.Turneringsmotoren støtter både åpen poen: The tournament engine supports both open ladders, playoffs, and Swiss style formats, combined with class teams and digital paddles with a local touch.
translations.På eldre TV skjermer i kantina frøs vanl: On older cafeteria TVs, standard HTML video in iframes froze, so the main screen uses animated WebP and three display layers with a custom ES5 fallback.
translations.Backenden kjører i Node.js med innebygd: The backend runs on Node.js with built in SQLite and only five npm packages, stress tested with one hundred concurrent players and built so that names and emails are deleted after approval.
translations.Allerede på dag to i kantina økte aktivi: Already on day two in the cafeteria, activity increased to 21 matches before lunch was over, and we added schedule management for the tables and simple nickname moderation.
translations.Arbeidet med Ember Booking startet med i: The work on Ember Booking started with insights from busy business owners who spent far too much time manually reconciling Vipps, Excel, and accounting.
translations.Landingssiden i Next.js 16 er bygget opp: The landing page in Next.js 16 is built step by step from concrete pain points to customer stories from pilot users who save five to seven hours a month.
translations.I hverdagen har jeg ansvaret for designs: In my everyday work, I handle the design system, the brand, and the frontend so the entire platform stays clean and easy to use.
translations.Målet med porteføljen var å teste hvorda: The goal of the portfolio was to test how a conversational voice interface that controls the screen based on fixed facts could also be used in healthcare, education, and customer service.
translations.Selv om 3D figuren har tjue blendshapes: Even though the 3D figure has twenty blendshapes for mouth syncing and expressions, it runs in a dedicated OffscreenCanvas Web Worker reused across the entire site at 60 fps.
translations.Stemmen er klonet fra sytten sekunder ly: The voice is cloned from seventeen seconds of audio recording, and chat bubbles wait for the Web Audio API so that text, speech, and lip movements all start at the exact same time.
translations.Jeg samlet reglene mine i et eget repo f: I gathered my rules in a separate repo because the quality of code agents depends on locking down the boundaries beforehand.
translations.For å hindre dobbeltbooking tegnet jeg o: To prevent double booking, I sketched out timelines on paper so the validation catches any partial overlaps between doctor appointments, while guest booking reuses existing patient rows.
translations.Til slutt skrev jeg om datahentingen i R: Finally, I rewrote the data fetching in React from Zustand to TanStack Query with backend pagination, short lived JWT tokens in memory, and role based access for admins.
translations.I Cinemorra er App Router delt i egne ru: In Cinemorra, the App Router is divided into dedicated route groups for the public movie catalog and a protected admin panel controlled via middleware.
translations.Kort fortalt har denne porteføljen ingen: In short, this portfolio has no user accounts, no tracking cookies, and no database storing what you type or say in the chat. Here is an open overview of what happens under the hood.
translations.Før jeg utdannet meg i backendutvikling: Before studying backend and frontend development at Noroff, I worked at Ekornes. I started on the production floor assembling furniture and programming Motoman industrial robots before moving on to team lead and department manager with responsibility for staff, daily operations planning, and quality control. That background is why I like contributing with more than just code, such as understanding the business and daily operations, taking part in legal considerations (like contracts, privacy, and business rules), and being part of the bigger decisions.
translations.Fjell, telt og hunden: Mountains, tent camping, and the dog
translations.Det var først høsten 2026 at jeg bestemt: It was not until autumn 2026 that I decided to give AI assisted software development a proper try with a structured methodology. When AI handles more of the typing, I get more time at both ends of the work, both to plan the architecture properly at the start and to polish the user experience details at the end.
translations.Etter mye egen prøving og feiling landet: After plenty of trial and error on my own, I landed on a rhythm that turned out to be an established method called Spike and Stabilize, described by Dan North. First, I build a quick initial version all the way from database to UI (Spike) to see if the idea actually works. Once the core feature holds up, I switch to Stabilize where I clear away noise, handle edge cases, and get the code ready for production.
translations.Å bruke KI til sparring på egen maskin e: Using AI for sparring on your own machine is straightforward. Things change as soon as you put a public chat online and let it control what happens on the screen. When I reviewed the code for the 3D chat on this site, I found three things that needed tightening. Info about which page you were on was sent straight into the system prompt without validation, the tag that switches pages ([GO:...]) lacked an allowlist of valid routes, and the voice calls were missing an explicit store: false.
translations.VGS Bordtennis startet som et forsøk på: VGS Bordtennis started as an effort to include more students during recess, aiming to make something fun that made it easier to join in around the table tennis tables and be active together. It is a real time system in Node.js for tournaments and a big screen scoreboard, using a QR code at the table.
translations.Siden ulike skoler og friminutt har fors: Because different schools and breaks have different needs, the tournament engine supports King of the Hill (an open points ladder with 3 points per win and automatic signup at the table where anyone can play anyone), playoffs with group stages and knockout rounds, and Swiss style with fixed rounds where everyone plays until the end.
translations.I slike TV nettlesere krever systemet et: In these TV browsers, the system requires a physical user click before a <video> is allowed to play. If you call video.play() in an iframe without a click, the browser does not throw an error, it simply leaves the promise pending forever so the video freezes on the first frame. Chromium also throttles timers in cross domain iframes to full minute boundaries, skipping standard second based polling.
translations.Evaluering og tiltak etter to dager i dr: Evaluation and changes after two days in production
translations.Tidsstemplene viste faste bølger gjennom: The timestamps showed steady waves through the school day, with a quick round before class at 08:08, a mid morning session, and 9 back to back matches over 72 minutes during the lunch break with zero downtime at the table. The time from one finished match to the next pair starting was down to 12 to 38 seconds, and when there was a queue, students chose quick single set matches (3 to 4 minutes) before switching to best of 3 sets once things quieted down. The rules against table monopoly (max 2 ranked matches per pair per day and opponent rotation) kicked in automatically 4 times during the day and logged extra games as free play, leaving three students tied at the top of the leaderboard.
translations.Målgruppe og innsikt i hvem vi bygger fo: Target audience and insight into who we build for
translations.Kim og jeg tar jevnlige statusmøter der: Kim and I hold regular status meetings where we review the road ahead for the company, set strategy, and divide tasks between us. My responsibility is everything that meets the user visually and in the frontend, from the brand, design system, and marketing pages to keeping the user experience calm, readable, and tidy on both mobile and desktop.
translations.Denne oppryddingen viste en viktig detal: This cleanup revealed an important detail in how EF Core builds SQL. As long as the mapping lived directly inside a .Select(a => new DTO { Doctor = ... }) expression, EF Core knew to fetch the Doctor relation automatically. When I switched to .Select(a => a.ToAppointmentWithDetailsDTO()), EF Core could no longer read the expression tree and threw an error because related data was missing. The fix was to add explicit calls to .Include() in the queries.
translations.Samme oppsett har tydelig nytteverdi i a: The same setup is useful in other industries. In healthcare, it can give older adults and patients calm spoken guidance through forms and preparation. In schools, students can practice speaking in a safe setting, and in customer support, companies can guide users visually through an issue without the model making up its own answers.
translations.Når en språkmodell får sende ut tagger s: When a language model is allowed to emit tags that control the page ([TOUR:<slug>], [GO:<path>], and [FILE:cv]), you cannot blindly trust input coming from the browser. When I reviewed the code for the 3D chat, I found three things that needed tightening. Info about which page the user was on was sent straight into the system prompt without sanitization, the [GO:...] tag lacked an allowlist of valid routes, and the voice calls were missing an explicit store: false.
translations.For å skille de åpne sidene tydelig fra: To separate the public pages cleanly from administration, the app uses route groups in the Next.js App Router, with an open section ((home)) where visitors can filter by genre, search the catalog, watch trailers, and read reviews, and a protected section ((dashboard)/admin) for adding, editing, and deleting movies.

translations.Spillerens aktive rekkert, seiersprosent: Active paddle, win rate, time at the table, trophies, and paddle trades.

translations.Ut fra dette bygde jeg opp budskapet run: From there, I built the messaging around fast Vipps payments without long forms, fully reconciled accounting with Tripletex and Fiken, and a system ready in one day.
translations.Før jeg skrev kode tegnet jeg databasen: Before writing code, I sketched the database in third normal form and imported the schema from MySQL back into dbdiagram to check that tables and unique indexes matched the plan.
translations.Etter hvert som modellene vokste skrev j: As the models grew, I wrote custom extension mappers in C sharp instead of AutoMapper, and discovered that EF Core requires explicit calls to Include when mapping moves out of Select.
translations.For å sikre mot prompt injection ligger: To guard against prompt injection, the checks live in regular TypeScript code around the model, where messages are sanitized and all tags controlling the page are checked against fixed lists on the server and client.
translations.Repoet er delt i tre moduler som styrer: The repo is split into three modules that manage calm surfaces and colors in the UI, lean architecture with short context, and natural language where motivation comes before technical details.
translations.Innlogging, utlån og filmendringer går g: Logins, rentals, and movie updates run through Server Actions with clean UI state in Zustand, while search, forms, and accessibility are tested with Jest and React Testing Library.
